top_choice_rationale: The narrowly defined GLP-1 physiological achievement provides the strongest combination of fundamental insight, decades of maturation, and broad demonstrated therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity. The Holst-Mojsov-Drucker allocation is defensible for this enabling physiological boundary, without claiming to recognize the full later drug-development enterprise.
recusal_note: None apparent from the supplied profile; documented scientific connections concern motor-circuit neuroscience and do not indicate involvement with the proposed achievement or laureates.
